steps.name: Owner A signs in with their own account
Owner A creates the project and saves the first version
Owner B signs in with a separate account and session
Owner B sees the shared agency project and A's content
after sign-out Owner A's old session can no longer open the project
Owner A, in a brand-new session, recovers exactly the version saved by B
version history records the author of every version (A, then B)
Owner A restores v1 → creates v3 (A's content) and keeps v1 and v2
Owner B sees the restored content after reloading
concurrent saves: the first wins, the second gets a version conflict and overwrites nothing
retry after a lost response: confirmed as saved, exactly ONE new version (no duplicate)
a user outside Avalon (no membership) cannot open the project
RLS: the outsider reads 0 rows and modifies nothing with their own JWT
anonymous visitor: redirected to login; anonymous API reads nothing

identities: two separate synthetic owner accounts + one synthetic non-member, isolated Supabase only
